# AI · safety

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Prompt injection
- What: Stop instructions hidden in content the AI reads from taking control of it.
- Applies when: an AI model reads content its user did not write, or can take actions.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Text planted in content the AI reads, telling it to ignore its rules, does not change what the app does or reveal private data.

### Jailbreak resistance
- What: Keep the AI within its rules when users try to talk it out of them.
- Applies when: the public can chat with the app's AI.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Content moderation
- What: Check what users post, and what the AI writes, for harmful content.
- Applies when: the public can post content or see AI output.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### PII redaction
- What: Remove personal details from text before it is sent to an AI model.
- Applies when: personal data is sent to an AI model.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Personal details the model does not need are removed before the text is sent.
